rationale: With only 19 minutes to close, CMG is trading at 84% of its intraday range after a speculative acquisition-driven spike of ~7% today, with price consolidating tightly near $32.94-$32.99 and no clear directional momentum in the last 5 candles. The news catalyst is explicitly unconfirmed and speculative, making a long risky given the potential for mean-reversion into the close, while a short against a strong news-driven move with elevated relative volume (5.62x) and price well above VWAP carries equal risk. The reward-to-risk profile in either direction does not justify entry with less than 20 minutes remaining and end-of-day liquidation risk.
